description: Alberta annual motor-vehicle casualty statistics report the numbers of injuries and fatalities for each year from 2001 through 2014. A CSV table and PDF official-statistic visualisation are two representations of the same resource. The metadata traces the figures to Annual Traffic Collision Statistics and mentions descriptions of historical highs and lows. It establishes observed transport safety outcomes. It does not establish collision coordinates, road-segment linkage, accident-level records, exposure denominators or injury-severity categories. The dataset is retained as annual provincial statistics; no recent casualty trend or numerical result is inferred from the historical metadata. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves source identifiers and descriptive metadata. Provider: Government of Alberta; Transportation. Licence: Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs and current file access are unverified. Access metadata says unrestricted; isopen is false. No linked dataset, workbook, document, archive or model/code body was retrieved. Specific simulation applications beyond the stated role are unknown. Related source components retain their own identities.
